mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a pleasant 58 degrees with clear skies by Badger Ridge Middle School. The moon is currently a Waxing Gibbous, and although the ISS will pass overhead tonight, it will be obscured by cloud cover.
Contractors will begin chip seal road treatment on September 23. While roads stay open, expect lane closures and traffic control on Cross Country Road, East Verona Avenue, and Liberty Business Park.

Today you can head to Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow is packed with activities, including Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters at Lake Lou-ee, and more throughout the week including the Verona Fall Fest this Thursday.
On September 5, an officer investigated a series of reports involving vehicles with cheese on their windshields in various neighborhoods, which was identified as a social media trend.
Culver's is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM for all your cravings.
